officialAvailabilityAssessment.US: Existing SEC seeder and checkpointed current-market backfill are in repo. SEC companyfacts/submissions bulk ZIPs total about 2.98 GB; existing per-CIK workflow avoids repeatedly downloading full archives. SEC companyfacts are current facts, not complete filing-vintage data for point-in-time backtests.
officialAvailabilityAssessment.TW: Existing OpenAPI fundamentals do not provide a ten-year three-statement history. MOPS redirectToOld returned HTTP 200/result URLs for 2016Q1 income, balance-sheet, and cash-flow queries, but each historical result fetch returned upstream HTTP 503; no historical values were downloaded. TWSE OpenAPI is licensed under the government open-data license but only serves current seasons. TPEx reuse/republication needs dataset-specific authorization; MOPS historical redistribution terms were not verified.

limitations: Company listing/incorporation dates are not present, so eligibility-adjusted completeness is unknown.
Legacy financial JSON has period end and fiscal labels, but generally no filingDate, acceptedAt, accession number, or restatement vintage; no legacy period is certified point-in-time usable.
Null values are not tagged as not-applicable versus missing; field completeness is descriptive, not an error rate.
A financial JSON file or legacy quality.good label does not certify ten-year coverage.
Current ticker directories do not form a complete historical delisted-company directory; index-only symbols are candidates only.
Foreign reporter status alone does not establish whether quarterly filings are required in each jurisdiction.
